title: Vega-Lite lab
description: Write and fix a Vega-Lite chart spec against your tables: see compile errors, warnings and the live chart.
needs: an object with spec (a Vega-Lite spec: an object with at least one key) and tables ([{ id, rows: [row objects] }] or [{ id, csv: CSV text, delimiter? }]) that the spec names with {"data": {"name": id}}

tools.name: setSpec
tools.description: Replace the whole Vega-Lite spec (a JSON object). Tables are read with {"data": {"name": id}}.

tools.name: patchSpec
tools.description: Set one value in the spec at a JSON pointer such as /encoding/x/field (/- appends to an array). The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist: with no /encoding/color, set it to {"field": "region", "type": "nominal"}, not /encoding/color/field.

tools.name: removeSpecKey
tools.description: Remove the value at a JSON pointer from the spec.

tools.name: setTable
tools.description: Replace a table's rows, or add a table with this id; rows is an array of objects. A CSV table stays CSV.

tools.name: reorderTables
tools.description: Move a table to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: compileReport
tools.description: Whether the spec compiles: errors, warnings, the tables and the Vega marks it makes.

tools.name: describeTables
tools.description: Every table's columns with type, min, max, distinct and null counts, and 3 sample rows.
